title: People on the train
question: Which passenger encounters would you like? Proposed Japanese lines include English subtitles.

options.label: train-aoi: Aoi realises where Eric will work
options.note: Original kept. Jørgen rejected the proposed replacement.

options.label: train-bun: She brought back too much
options.note: Shortened version selected by the authors under C-0193. One bag-closing gesture and one thank-you; seat hint names the lunchbox.

options.label: train-youth: The goal he keeps looking at
options.note: He is pleased with his first goal even though his team lost badly.

options.label: train-music: She is listening to her own practice
options.note: The headphones belong to someone trying to get a guitar part right.

options.label: train-reader: The book and the work computer
options.note: His new Excel book does not match the old version he has to use at work.

options.label: train-hamada: Hamada silences his reminder
options.note: His reminder is working; he has learned to dismiss it in his sleep.

links.label: Read each complete encounter and choose

decision: Author decision by Codex under C-0193, following Claude cold-read fixes and the recorded player feedback: retain original train-aoi; use the shortened train-bun; select the current complete proposals for train-youth, train-music, train-reader and train-hamada in frames.json. These four are our writing decisions, not additional picks by Jørgen. Preserve English subtitles and the shown prop/audio staging; no extra closing quips, lessons, inventory or later-day promises. Implementation and voice remain work #6; this decision does not claim the encounters are live.
